content: Multi-store vs consolidated UX: Shopify's multi-store reporting (launched 2025) is the reference implementation — single toggle/selector switches between 'All stores' and individual store views. Key patterns: (1) global KPIs remain visible at org level; (2) store picker dropdown or tab strip at top of page; (3) consolidated view = sum of all stores; (4) per-store drilldown = same UI template filtered by store; (5) score/alerts also need to clearly indicate which store they belong to. Fullmetrix and Metorik show that third-party analytics for multi-store operations always default to consolidated with drill-through to per-store — never per-store-only.
